title: Stir Fry Skirt Steak with Vegetables
description: A quick and flavorful Chinese stir-fry recipe featuring skirt steak, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This dish is easy to make and can be customized with your favorite vegetables.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat.
2. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
3. Add the skirt steak and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked to your desired level of doneness.
4. Remove the steak from the skillet and set aside to rest.
5. Add the sliced bell pepper and chopped bok choy to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
6. Return the steak to the skillet and add the light soy sauce and stir-fry seasoning.
7. Stir everything together and cook for an additional minute.
8. Serve the steak hot, garnished with sliced green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
9. Slice the steak against the grain and serve with the stir-fried vegetables.
